baseline: babcb28 plus pre-existing working tree changes
scope: local source audit, rebuilt package tests, mock-provider experiment and synthetic scheduler benchmark; no live provider request

policyProjection.measurement: UTF-8 JSON bytes, not provider tokens

toolSelection.note: Catalog bytes exclude Host-added plan tools, invoke and description suffixes. Continuation uses approvedPlanRequest with a synthetic one-item plan, not a real accepted user task.

cases.request: 把选中的立方体改成蓝色
给按钮加一个自身呼吸动画

harnessConcurrencyProbe.method: Mock fetch returns two native scene.query calls in one response. Consumer schedules each tool result 100ms after its request. No real model or editor is used.

schedulerBenchmark.warning: The script's modelCalls 3/1 fields are constants, not measured provider requests. This does not establish end-to-end DeepSeek speedup.

limitations: No live-provider latency, token, cost or success-rate experiment was performed.
No complete npm run check was run for this documentation-only analysis.
Byte measurements and fixture timings are not predictions of production token savings or latency.
